newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 15.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Formosa Plastic Group chairman Wang Yung-ching presses ahead with multibillion U.S. dollar thermal power plant project in southern Chinese city of Zhangzhou
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan takes delivery of two U.S. F-16 fighter jets a day ahead of schedule
LIBERTY TIMES - Farmers association members arrested after election for alleged vote-buying, then released
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Government to introduce five-day work week every other week
Top securities watchdog Lu Tung-ying to head to Beijing for international securities meeting
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - First mainland China ship expected to sail to Kaohsiung in southern Taiwan
Taiwan resumes import of South Korean cars
